protocols.reason: ADJUDICATED 2026-09-05 (ledger L167): `protocols` has NO insert anywhere in the repo — not in server code, not in migrations, not even a seed — so it is empty on every deployment. Its one UPDATE (protocol-analyzer-service.ts:422) writes an embedding cache onto a row it just read, so it is empty-by-construction rather than an independent writer. Two consumers: findSimilarProtocols, which therefore always returns [], and strategic-report-generator, which has no callers and already fails closed ('Protocol not found'). The empty read is NOT correct — but the harm sits in the consumer, not here: POST /api/analytics/demo-analysis renders the always-zero count into a wisdom_trace 'Evidence Base' as "Compared against database of 0 similar protocols". See L167 for that and for the gate hole around it.

qSubCommitments.reason: ADJUDICATED 2026-09-05 (ledger L166): the capture half of the Pre-Sub cycle is unbuilt. The only mutation anywhere in product code is setCommitmentRolledIn (q-sub.service.ts), exposed as PATCH /api/q-sub/commitments/:id/rolled-in and as the AnA tool update_q_sub_commitment_rolled_in — both UPDATE-by-id, so on any real tenant they can never match a row. The only INSERT INTO q_sub_commitments is scripts/seed-mdx-beta.mjs, a beta seed, which is not a writer. AnA's own W3 Pre-Sub workflow instructs the user to "record their answer and capture commitments", a step the product provides no control for. So an empty read is NOT correct — it is a missing feature, and the readers see an empty set for that reason. Downstream: proposeCommitmentRollup has no callers, and the Pre-Sub Manager renders an honest "No commitments yet". Build the capture path or retire the cycle — a product call, recorded not made.
